1. Scope — Specifies certain dimensions relating to the interchangeability of wing bases for columns 
used in special purpose machines constructed from modular units. 

2. Nominal Sizes 

2.1 The nominal size of a wing base for column shall be given by the nominal width of the saddle on 
the related slide unit ( see IS : 9722-1981 Dimensions for modular units for machine tool construction 
— slide units ) which is to be accommodated on the column. 

2.2 The nominal width of a wing base for mounting a column is one size larger than the nominal 
width of a wing base for mounting a slide unit since the width of the column is larger than that of 
a slide unit 



3. Dimensions 

3.1 Range of Nominal Sizes from 250 to 630 mm — As specified in Table 1 . 

4. Location of Wing Bases 

4.1 Wing bases for columns shall be located on centre bases by means of either of the following two 
forms: 

Form A — For locating wing bases for columns on centre bases with dowels and tenons. 
Form B — For locating wing bases for columns on centre ( preferred ) bases with tenons. 

4.2 If dowels are used, the dowel holes shall be midway between upper pair of fixing bolts as shown 
in Table 1, irrespective of which bolting pattern is employed and dowel pin shall be perpendicular to 
joint face. 

4.3 The locations of wing bases for columns on centre bases for Form A and Form B ( see 4.1 ) have 
been given in Appendix A. 

6. Designation — A wing base for column. Form A of nominal size 260 mm, height 560 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Wing Base for Column A 260 x 660 IS : 10188 
6. Typical applications of modular units has been given in Appendix B.
